A gender reveal confetti cannon is a handheld tube filled with biodegradable pink or blue confetti that you twist to release in one spectacular burst. How Do Gender Reveal Confetti Cannons Work?

Confetti cannons are incredibly simple to use, which makes them perfect for nervous first-time parents! Safe for the whole family
